name: zinput_bindmap_context_set_mouse_binding
description: zInput_BindMapContext::SetMouseBinding updates a command's mouse slot and the reverse slot-to-command lookup.
known_limits: tier S verification is accepted by the zinput_bindmap_mouse_binding_wrappers VC target.
